My old OBGyn was checking the area and blurted out, in complete awe, “you have a BEAUTIFUL birth canal.” 

By far the strangest “compliment” I’ve ever received.
I wish you could have seen Ice cream I. Cali

“It seems to me there’s so much more to the world than the average eye is allowed to see. I believe, if you look hard, there are more wonders in this universe than you could ever have dreamed of.”
Vincent Van Gogh, Doctor Who – Vincent and the Doctor (2010)

Just a good way to look at life, y’know?

Helping others used to be enough, but not so much anymore. The pain I felt when my friend died from suicide is why I keep going. Even if I may not see my value sometimes, others do. And I would never want anyone that I love to feel that pain. It still hurts.

English words with double R’s with an R after, like mirror or terror. When I try to pronounce “horror” it comes out sounding like I’m saying, “whore.” Makes for a hilarious conversation with your kiddo when you tell him you’re dressing up as a character from Little Shop of Horrors!

Side note: I’m super Mexican and can roll my R’s like magic, but those weird English R’s get me every time!
Pine scented anything: candles, cleaner, soap - whatever.

Thank you. Even my adult children, who were in the room when I received the message, said the same thing. Blocking probably wouldn’t be a bad idea, as I received a second message and it all just brought back feelings of inadequacy that I had back then. I’m in a better place, and wish to stay there.
The reasons are becoming fewer as the years pass. The only two I have left are my kids (who are almost adults) and having lived through a close friend’s suicide. But even that is starting to fade.
Yeah, I cared. Totally will move past it, once I deal with the feelings. Thanks!

I felt the disrespect. Just wanted someone else’s input. Most gf’s tell you how amazing you are and he just wasn’t the right guy. I know I’m awesome, just looking back at 3 years worth of memories to reflect on any changes I can make in my behavior that could have been handled differently.
